name: Feature request

labels: enhancement, needs-triage

## Summary

One-line description of the feature.

## Problem / motivation

What gap or need does this address? (1–3 sentences.)

## Proposed solution

What should be built? (Concrete behavior, not implementation details.)

## Phase / milestone alignment

- **Phase:** (0–9, or N/A)
- **Milestone:** (e.g. Milestone 6.4 OnionShare, 4.2 content distribution; or "out of scope – justify")

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Constraints (cultural / security)

- Cultural: info-only guardrails (no access gating). Note if feature touches content or metadata.
- Security: note if feature touches Tor, auth, or sensitive data.

## Checklist

- [ ] Searched existing issues for the same idea
